releases.notes:
Waystones Item Cost Extended 1.2.0 adds optional native integration with Lightmans Currency (1.21-2.3.0.6+) on Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge. Lightmans Currency is optional and never bundled.

Teleport requirements can charge any coin registered in native CoinAPI, including custom chains. Separate chains cannot fund one another. Coins are drawn from equipped native or Curios wallets via WalletHandler, hotbar, main inventory, and occupied offhand stacks. Bank accounts are not debited, and loose wallets are not opened.

Native CoinContainerMoneyHandler evaluates pre-mutation snapshots for combined previews, committing after checking both inventory and wallet snapshots; all changed touched storage is guarded before commit. Native requirement rollback restores touched slots and wallet snapshots once when storage still matches the committed state; changed touched slots are never overwritten. Creative mode and zero-cost routes remain free.

Denomination arithmetic honors configured rates and wallet auto-exchange settings. Charges are refused upfront if change cannot fit into the wallet or main inventory. Native coin costs require no toggle; recipePayments remains false by default.

releases.notes:
## Waystones Item Cost Extended 1.1.0

- Rename Paid Waystones to Waystones Item Cost Extended.
- Support payment with items connected by reversible compression and decompression recipes. Enable with `recipePayments=true` in `config/waystones-item-cost-extended.properties`.
- Combine different item currencies in one payment on legacy Waystones versions.
- Share one inventory transaction and RinLib payment planner across supported Minecraft versions.
- Add the new pixel icon, configuration examples, and six in-game screenshots.

Requires RinLib 1.0.2.
